newsitem.title: CHINA: Pudong exports rise 7.5 percent in January-August.
newsitem.headline: Pudong exports rise 7.5 percent in January-August.

text.p: Exports from the Pudong New Area, China's hottest development zone in Shanghai, rose by a year-on-year 7.5 percent to $2 billion in the first eight months of this year, the China Daily said on Sunday.
The amount accounted for 22.5 percent of all Shanghai exports in the period, the newspaper said.
The rise was partly due to an increase in exports by sino-foreign joint ventures in the area, which rose by a year-on-year 61 percent to $290 million, the newspaper said.
